title: Bounded delete retries and stuck verdict
prerequisites: Explicit approval for narrowly scoped fault injection against a recorded disposable QA workspace; no production faults, shared Docker daemon disruption or global API changes.
Q01 baseline verified; capture QA reaper verdicts and workspace/build IDs before fault.
Fault fixture must target one QA workspace delete transition, support fail-once and consecutive failed/canceled delete builds, and be removable without affecting other workspaces.

Q03-a.fixture: One transient scoped QA delete-build failure, then restore

Q03-b.fixture: Three consecutive scoped failed/canceled delete builds, then restore; no fourth injected failure

variants.title: Transient deletion recovers

steps.action: Record QA-owned disposable workspace and enable one-shot delete failure; finish its provider turn and runner, then verify first delete build fails or cancels.
steps.expected: Exactly the targeted QA delete failed once; no other workspace touched.
steps.evidence: Fixture authorization, workspace ID, failed delete build ID/time and sanitized verdict.

steps.action: Remove fault immediately; poll workspace/build and reaper every 30s for up to three observed sweeps (allow sweep runtime gap).
steps.expected: Retry succeeds and recorded workspace is deleted within three observed sweeps; no stuck verdict from a single failure.
steps.evidence: UTC sweep/verdict/build IDs and final workspace absence.

cleanup: Disable fault; if still present, request explicit authorization for targeted manual QA deletion and report failed cleanup until confirmed.

variants.title: Three failures stop automatic retries

steps.action: On a new explicitly disposable QA workspace inject three successive failed/canceled delete builds; after each, poll build history every 15s and identify the completed attempt before allowing next sweep.
steps.expected: Three consecutive delete builds fail/cancel only for this workspace; status/verdict becomes stuck after third failure.
steps.evidence: Three distinct build IDs, completion times, sanitized reaper verdicts and QA workspace ID.

steps.action: Disable fault and observe at least two subsequent reaper sweeps without manual deletion.
steps.expected: No fourth automatic delete build; stuck verdict/status remains visible, not a silently retried loop.
steps.evidence: Before/after build count and UTC sweep timestamps.

cleanup: After observation, obtain or reuse explicit QA-only manual deletion approval, manually delete only recorded fixture and verify absence; otherwise mark cleanup blocked and escalate to owner.

notes: Do not use failed provisioning builds as substitutes for failed delete builds.
If the injector cannot isolate a QA workspace, mark both variants blocked; no destructive fallback.
